Client Data

group FIRMWARE_DISTRIBUTION_CLIENT_DATA

Data types and structures used by client-side data processing.

Defines

FW_DIST_CLIENT_RECVS_STATUS 0

Status of receiving. Uses fw_dist_client_recvs_status_t.

FW_DIST_CLIENT_RECVS_LIST 1

List of receiving. Uses fw_dist_client_recvs_list_t.

FW_DIST_CLIENT_CAPS_STATUS 2

Capabilities status. Uses fw_dist_client_caps_status_t.

FW_DIST_CLIENT_STATUS 3

Status of distribution. Uses fw_dist_client_dist_status_t.

FW_DIST_CLIENT_UPLOAD_STATUS 4

Upload status report. Uses fw_dist_client_upload_status_t.

FW_DIST_CLIENT_FW_STATUS 5

Firmware status report. Uses fw_dist_client_fw_status_t.

struct fw_dist_client_recvs_status_t

Client receivers status structure.

Public Members

uint16_t src

Source address of client receiver.

fw_dist_status_code_t status

Status code of client receiver.

uint16_t recvs_list_cnt

Count of receivers in client list.

struct fw_dist_client_recvs_list_t

List structure for client receivers.

Public Members

uint16_t src

Source address of client list.

uint16_t recvs_list_cnt

Count of receivers in client list.

uint16_t first_index

First index of client receivers in list.

fw_update_node_t *pentries

Pointer to entries of client nodes.

uint8_t entries_cnt

Count of entries in client list.

struct fw_dist_client_caps_status_t

Client capabilities status structure.

Public Members

uint16_t src

Source address of client capabilities.

fw_dist_caps_t dist_caps

Capabilities of client distribution.

struct fw_dist_client_dist_status_t

Client distribution status structure.

Public Members

uint16_t src

Source address of client distribution.

fw_dist_status_code_t status

Status code of client distribution.

fw_dist_phase_t phase

Current phase of client distribution.

uint16_t dist_multicast_addr

Multicast address for client distribution.

uint16_t dist_appkey_index

App key index for client distribution.

uint8_t dist_ttl

Time-to-live for client distribution messages.

uint16_t dist_timeout_base

Timeout base in seconds for client distribution.

uint8_t dist_transfer_mode

Transfer mode of client distribution.

uint8_t update_policy

Update policy for client distribution.

uint8_t rfu

Reserved for future use.

uint16_t dist_fw_image_idx

Index of firmware image for client distribution.

struct fw_dist_client_upload_status_t

Client upload status structure.

Public Members

uint16_t src

Source address of client upload.

uint8_t status

Status code of client upload.

fw_upload_phase_t phase

Current phase of client upload.

uint8_t upload_progress

Progress percentage of client upload.

bool upload_oob

Out-of-band flag for client upload.

uint8_t *pupload_fw_id

Pointer to firmware ID buffer for upload.

uint8_t upload_fw_id_len

Length of firmware ID for client upload.

struct fw_dist_client_fw_status_t

uint8_t status

Status code of client firmware.

uint16_t entry_cnt

Count of entries in client firmware status.

uint16_t dist_fw_image_idx

Image index in client firmware status.

uint8_t *pfw_id

uint8_t fw_id_len

Length of firmware ID for client firmware status.
